title: Evidence records
description: What each cited record says, for the provenance panel. Generated by scripts/build_data.py. GROUND-TRUTH.md C-25: src/components/base/data.ts:181 declared a loader for this file while the file did not exist, so evidenceRecords() returned an empty object on every call and the panel could only ever show the index stub. Nothing here is composed: a field the record does not carry is absent, and an absent field renders no row rather than an empty one.

value.description: As the record states it. Never re-rounded here.

uncertainty.description: Written as the record writes it, for example a plus-or-minus figure or the words 'not characterised'. From the record, never composed.

trust.description: THE RUNG WORD, one of the four in data/refusals.json's ladder, and the field every component reads. It used to be the rung integer stringified, so provenance-chip rendered "trust 2" with no --trust-* colour on every chip on the site. Two mappings exist and they run in opposite directions: the library's TrustLevel is rung to name, and data.ts's trustRung is name to index. This is the first.

trustRung.description: The same rung as the integer the store wrote, beside the word rather than instead of it, for anything comparing rungs. Never rendered as a trust level.

stats.description: Extra rows for the panel and nowhere else. A refusal's statistics go here, not on the card face.
